spec.title: Create new terminal for each kanban action instead of reusing
spec.context: When a kanban action is triggered from the VSCode extension, the current implementation reuses an existing terminal. If Claude is still running from a previous command, sending a new command results in that text being sent as input to the running Claude session rather than starting a fresh instance. This breaks the context-isolation design where each kanban action should run with a clean Claude context.

in-scope.item: Modify terminal capability to dispose existing terminal before creating new one
Rename getOrCreateTerminal to createFreshTerminal to reflect new behavior
Update all call sites in extension.ts

requirements.requirement: The terminal capability shall dispose the existing "Claude Kanban" terminal before creating a new one
The terminal capability function shall be renamed from getOrCreateTerminal to createFreshTerminal
All call sites in extension.ts shall be updated to use the renamed function
The new terminal shall be created with the same configuration (name, cwd, icon) as before

files.file: Change getOrCreateTerminal to createFreshTerminal. Add logic to dispose existing terminal before creating new one.
Update three call sites (lines 223, 242, 256) to use createFreshTerminal instead of getOrCreateTerminal.

patterns.pattern: Terminal capability uses factory function with closure for state management. Reference: terminal.capability.ts:13-50
All VSCode API calls (including terminal.dispose()) stay in capabilities, not computers. Reference: vscode-integration directive

product.finding: Current design documents "Reused for subsequent actions" as intended behavior. This task changes that design to "Disposed and recreated for each action" to ensure clean Claude context.

engineering.finding: Terminal capability is one of four capabilities in the extension. The orchestrator (extension.ts) calls terminal methods from three command handlers.

codebase.finding: Current getOrCreateTerminal checks if kanbanTerminal exists and is still in vscode.window.terminals. If yes, reuses it. The cached terminal reference is only cleared when terminal is externally closed.
Three call sites follow identical pattern: getOrCreateTerminal → showTerminal → sendCommand

pitfalls.finding: Terminal.dispose() is the correct VSCode API for closing a terminal programmatically. No race condition concern since we create the new terminal synchronously after dispose.

constraints.constraint: Must follow capability-computer pattern - VSCode API calls only in capabilities
Must maintain explicit return types on exported functions (typescript directive)

dependencies.external: None - uses existing VSCode Terminal API

risks.risk: Users accustomed to scrolling back in terminal history will lose that when terminal is recreated. This is acceptable as it enforces clean context.

spec.open-questions: None - all technical decisions resolved during scoping.
